name: Midsummer Sickle
body:
Source Faction Guide pg. 60
Aura moderate evocation CL 12th
Slot none; Price 7,806 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
Created by the druids of the Green Faith, this +1 mithral spell storing sickle serves as a divine focus for druids. It can only store spells on the druid spell list or from the Air, Earth, Fire, or Water domains or nature bond domain lists.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, creator must be a druid of at least 12th level; Price 4,306 gp
